compactness_test.polarization: any fixed very ample A on S
compactness_test.conclusion: Hilbert polynomial and Chow degree are unbounded with l; the carriers do not lie in one fixed projective Hilbert/Chow stratum.

common_curve_component.reason: Each carrier is integral. A common positive-dimensional component Gamma contained in two carriers would equal both carriers, contradicting their distinct numerical classes lD_1.

positive_dimensional_equigeneric_subsyst.reason: The retained U1 conductor calculation gives equigeneric rigidity degree by degree; there is no same-class positive-dimensional genus-one deformation to compactify.

one_flat_family_across_l.reason: Flat projective families have constant Hilbert polynomial, while P_l changes with l.

fixed_fibration_as_fibers.reason: A fiber class has self-intersection zero, whereas D_l^2=336*l^2>0.

fixed_fibration_as_multisections.reason: The retained data contain no theorem turning isolated integral genus-one curves in unbounded numerical classes into multisections of one fixed fibration with packet inheritance.

bounded_finitely_generated_subsystem.reason: H2 already failed the exact section-ring multiplication F/R adapter required for this reduction.

decision.strongest_safe_claim: Standard Hilbert/Chow compactness, common-component, same-class deformation, and fiber-class mechanisms do not convert an unbounded sequence of exact MB104 carriers into one fixed global structure. A stronger cuboid-specific structure theorem would be new input.
